info.title: Capital Franchise Supply Chain Management System API Document

get.description: Retrieve all franchise applications (supports pagination, filtering by status).

post.description: Partner submits application (personal info, premise address) along with storefront and land certificate images.

get.description: View application details including the list of contracts generated from this application.

patch.description: Admin approves or rejects the application. If approved, the system automatically generates a Contract and sends a DocuSeal link.

get.description: Retrieve all franchise contracts (supports pagination, filtering by status).
Retrieve detailed information of a franchise contract.

post.description: Change contract status to Active, create a new Store, and grant Manager role to the partner.

200.description: {"message": "Xác nhận thanh toán thành công. Hợp đồng đã có hiệu lực."}

post.description: Add valid years to the current contract.

patch.description: Admin updates the construction status (Design -> Construction -> Inspection -> Ready).
Admin changes the contract status (Suspended, Terminated) with a reason.

get.description: Retrieve all franchise applications submitted by the current user.
Retrieve all franchise contracts of the current user.

post.description: Update contract status (Signed) based on the webhook sent from DocuSeal. Uses HMAC Header instead of Token authentication.

get.description: Retrieve the paginated list of registered availability/unavailability for the current employee.
Retrieve all shift swap requests where the current logged-in user is either the sender or the receiver.
Retrieve the shift schedule within a specified date range for the logged-in staff member.

put.description: Check-in to a specific shift assignment using GPS location data.

get.description: Retrieve the current active shift details for the logged-in user.

put.description: Check-out from an active shift log using GPS location data.

get.description: Staff views their own time log history. The Gateway automatically binds the StaffID from the Token to ensure security.

patch.description: Manager reviews an application and updates its status (Approved/Rejected). The application ID is provided in the path.

200.description: {"message": "Đã cập nhật trạng thái đơn đăng ký"}

get.description: Managers view the complete list of employee availabilities to facilitate shift scheduling.

post.description: Submit a request for available or unavailable time to assist managers in scheduling.

delete.description: Remove a previously submitted availability request.

patch.description: Edit a submitted availability/unavailability request by its ID.

get.description: Retrieve shift rule configurations (Global and Store-specific) to display on the settings page.

parameters.description: Store ID (Optional, to filter by a specific store)
parameters.name: storeId

put.description: Create or update shift rules and constraints (e.g., maximum working hours, required break times).

get.description: Retrieve a complete list of all shift swap requests (typically for managers).

patch.description: After both employees agree to the swap, the Manager gives final approval to officially update the schedule.
The requesting employee can cancel their swap request if it hasn't been approved yet.
Employee B receives the swap request and chooses to Accept or Reject it.
patch.summary: Respond to a shift swap request

200.description: {"message": "Đã ghi nhận phản hồi đổi ca"}

get.description: Retrieve a complete list of shift templates (e.g., Morning, Afternoon, Night) for a specific store.

post.description: Define a new standard shift timeframe (including code, name, and start/end times).

get.description: Retrieve the detailed configuration of a specific shift template by its ID.

delete.description: Completely remove a shift template from the system.

patch.description: Modify the timeframe configuration or the name of an existing shift template.

get.description: Retrieve a list of shifts with applied filters (Used for Calendar/List view).

post.description: Create a new working shift for the store.

put.description: System automatically calculates and assigns suitable staff to empty (Draft) shifts based on availability and scheduling rules.

delete.description: Delete multiple shifts simultaneously (Only applicable for shifts currently in Draft status).

parameters.description: List of shift IDs to delete
parameters.name: body

post.description: Create multiple shifts simultaneously based on selected time frames and days of the week.

put.description: Change the status of multiple shifts from Draft to Open, allowing employees to apply for them in the Shift Pool. StoreId is automatically extracted from the Manager's Token.
put.summary: Bulk open shifts to Shift Pool

parameters.description: List of shift IDs to open
parameters.name: body

200.description: Returns the count of successfully opened shifts

put.description: Change the status of multiple shifts from Draft to Published, making them visible to employees on the schedule.

parameters.description: List of shift IDs to publish
parameters.name: body

post.description: Create multiple shifts over a specified period based on existing Shift Templates.

get.description: Manager retrieves all time logs within the Store, applying optional filters.

patch.description: Manager approves (Valid) or rejects (Invalid) an employee's actual worked shift.

get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific shift and its assigned staff.

delete.description: Delete a specific shift (Only allowed if it is in Draft or Planning status).

patch.description: Update shift timings or the required number of staff.

get.description: Manager views the list of applicants for a specific shift, along with their Smart Scores, to make approval decisions.

post.description: Employee applies for a specific shift. Creates a new ShiftApplication record. UserId is extracted from the authentication token.

201.description: {"message": "Gửi đơn đăng ký nhận ca thành công"}

put.description: Modify the list of employees assigned to a specific shift.

parameters.description: List of User IDs to assign
parameters.name: body

put.description: Change the shift status to Published, making it visible to employees on the schedule.

patch.description: The employee releases an assigned shift so other staff members can apply for it.
patch.summary: Release a shift to the Shift Pool

post.description: Employee A selects one of their assignments and requests a swap with Employee B.

get.description: Retrieve a list of stores with optional filtering (e.g., by city, district).
Find stores based on current location (Lat/Long) and radius.
Retrieve full details of a specific store by its ID.
Check if a store is currently open or active.
Check schedule conflicts and shift rules to suggest suitable staff members for a specific shift.
Lấy danh sách staff đang trong ca làm hiện tại của store

filledCount.description: Số slot đã điền được người

totalSlots.description: Tổng số slot trống cần xử lý

unfilledShiftIds.description: Danh sách ID các ca vẫn "mồ côi"

weeklyHoursWorked.description: Tổng giờ đã làm trong tuần

isOpenNow.description: Tính toán dựa trên StoreHours ngay lúc gọi

BearerAuth.description: Don't forget to type "Bearer" before the token. For example: Bearer eyJhbG...
